A_live_acceptance_and_readiness.prior_B2_scope_census: Resolved in source. A base-only run explicitly reports scope=base and is a legitimate bounded base run. With PROFILE_EXTENDED_CASES=1, the final verdict requires exactly one passed warm and extension_reload cell for each role-specific Identity, Employment and eight-expander case; missing, duplicate, unverified, provisional and unexpected cells prevent an extended pass.
A_live_acceptance_and_readiness.owned_restoration: The field journal durably records intended fields before each Save, validates the exact owner, organization, marker, creation time, version and intended field successor, and refuses conditional deletion with unresolved intent. A preexisting member row leaves saved-field cases unverified and is not a scope waiver; admin saved-field cases remain separately unverified.

Held reload verification likewise uses one generic operation for Identity and Employment. Both field mismatches become profile_unclassified_failure. After cleanup, the safe report cannot identify which extended case and dimension failed.
finding.source_bound_reproduction: Through the actual runProfileExecutionBoundary, Identity_extension_reload_First name_mismatch and Employment_extension_reload_Company_mismatch both yielded execution_failure_code=profile_unclassified_failure and identical execution_failure {stage:extension_reload,operation:extended_cases_after_reload}.
finding.minimal_repair: Set a fixed semantic case ID and dimension before each extended case and each held reload verification or restoration, and retain it through the existing safe failure boundary. No raw field values or Error.message are needed.

B_quality.guard_checks: 15 focused Node tests passed: owned journal (12), reload and census orchestration (2), native origin (1). Independent source-bound census probes rejected missing, duplicate, unverified and unexpected cells while accepting six complete member cells. The field successor guard rejects an intended-field mismatch. The existing orchestration test rejects a lost saved field before restoration.
